note: Templates only. Next deployment must merge rules into existing entrypoint rulesets; never replace other rules. Guard stays closed until account-wide analytics coverage is verified.

emergency_rule.expression: ((http.host eq "api.agents.hot" or http.host eq "pending.agents.hot" or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/pending") or http.request.uri.path eq "/mcp" or http.request.uri.path eq "/openapi.json" or http.request.uri.path eq "/health")) and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/internal/billing-")
emergency_rule.description: Agents Hot monthly included-usage emergency gate

reject_unknown_api_paths.expression: (http.host eq "api.agents.hot" and not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/internal/billing-") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/pending") or http.request.uri.path eq "/mcp" or http.request.uri.path eq "/openapi.json" or http.request.uri.path eq "/health"))
reject_unknown_api_paths.description: Agents Hot reject non-API paths before Workers

rate_rule.expression: (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/pending") or http.request.uri.path eq "/mcp" or http.request.uri.path eq "/openapi.json" or http.request.uri.path eq "/health" or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".json"))
rate_rule.description: Agents Hot API and public unread IP limit

reject_unknown_pending_paths.expression: (http.host eq "pending.agents.hot" and (not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/room_") or not http.request.uri.path contains "/agent_" or not ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".json") or http.request.uri.query ne "" or not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"}))
reject_unknown_pending_paths.description: Agents Hot public unread shape; no cache busting query strings

unread_cache_rule.description: Agents Hot unread public CDN cache

api_browser_integrity_rule.expression: (http.host eq "api.agents.hot" or (http.host in {"agents.hot" "pending.agents.hot"} and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/v1") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/pending") or http.request.uri.path in {"/mcp" "/health" "/openapi.json"} or (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/room_") and http.request.uri.path contains "/agent_" and ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".json")))))
api_browser_integrity_rule.description: Agents Hot API clients: disable Browser Integrity Check
